evidence_status: Recovered mechanism is an assumption; previous scores unavailable. New results exploratory on previously exposed data.
selection: Fixed contiguous indices independent of targets. All previously exposed to scan1; valid also scan2. Not campaign-independent.

tests.premise: Raw t0+t1 is determined by current 22 i0 price values within a sequence
tests.falsifier: At least 1% of rows disagree with modal quantized sum within exact repeated states, or repeated identical states have materially nonzero raw-sum spread
tests.control: Compare D=t0-t1 under identical grouping, plus sums paired with circularly shifted states by 997 rows. Shift is diagnostic only, never a causal feature
tests.quantum: Train/valid target minimum is diagnostic only and never used as model feature or selector

tests.premise: Current i0 prices transfer more sum information across sequences than difference information
tests.procedure: Train ridge using only 22 current i0 prices, standardization learned on train, rows >=99 stride 10. Ridge alpha 10; evaluate all scored valid rows >=99. Matched independently fit model with train targets circularly shifted 997 rows within each sequence. Score raw S,D R2 and global clipped target-weighted Pearson for predictions (S/2,S/2).
tests.falsifier: Sum R2 <=0 or aligned model fails to exceed shifted control; no baseline gain claim
tests.uncertainty: Per-sequence paired results descriptive only; unknown connected components prevent independence claims

tests.premise: Proposed model features are strictly current-only
tests.procedure: Exact compare first 256 feature rows computed on full sequence versus prefix; no labels in feature builder
